title: Gate D F1: verifier must read the final review verdict, not any 'verdict: PASS' substring
description: Found by Gate D (T022, agent-9e61; control node_modules/.cache/personal-word-beta/team-t021-review/controls/R5-*). scripts/verify-beta-evidence.py check_review() accepts a review as passed when the file contains the regex verdict:?\**\s*\**(passed|pass) ANYWHERE, so a FAIL review that merely mentions an earlier gate ('Gate A verdict: PASS') is accepted (R5: exit 2 instead of REVIEW-CLAIM-UNBACKED). Repair (only this function plus its controls): require one final-verdict line (e.g. the first markdown heading line matching '^#+ Verdict:' or an explicit 'Final verdict:' line) and accept only if that line begins with PASS; anything else -> REVIEW-CLAIM-UNBACKED. Fail-first: rerun R5 and a copy of the real Gate D 06-durability/REVIEW.md claimed passed with its sha256 BEFORE the fix (R5 accepted) and AFTER (R5 rejected, real Gate D review still accepted). Then, because scripts/** is in the source manifest, rerun evidence.md section 6 steps 2-4 only (write-source-manifest; make_evidence.py; verifier) and show exit 2 with only the pending items; no native or app rebuild needed (src/**, src-tauri/** untouched). If T022 is approved by then, set EVIDENCE.json review to {state: passed, reviewer: agent-9e61, reviewFile: docs/agent-work/2026-10-20-beta-roadmap/06-durability/REVIEW.md, reviewFileSha256: <current sha256>} and show exit 2 with exactly the 9 owner items; otherwise leave it pending and tell T023. No product code, no commits.
